component: Persistent Metal Add/Affine/Matmul provider using existing std/device resources and private retained read cursors

semantics.exact_accumulation: two integer words; final signed32 check; no float approximation or CPU result substitute

verified_behavior: Small matrix agrees with the independent source CPU backend and known exact bytes; all256 I8 octets are exercised.
Both I32 endpoints, positive and negative intermediate excursions returning into range, positive/negative overflow and a2^32 wraparound are checked.
Maximum262144-result and134217728-MAC matrices execute physically; the larger cases use analytic exact expected bytes beyond the source CPU backend own work limit.
Admitted read cursor retains Buffer and Session after their logical owners close; five reads return four262144-byte chunks and an empty terminator. New reads on the closed tensor fail.
Cancellation and deadline interrupt queued work behind a real Metal shared event; physical completion precedes resource release.
Malformed replies and large private diagnostics preserve cleanup; overflow/protocol failures do not become CPU fallback.
Metal and OpenCL reject each other opaque buffers with E_FFI/status5 before pointer use, without starting a kernel or read cursor; both modes clean up.
retained_attempts: First full1MiB result computed on GPU but exceeded the per-call FFI budget with value metadata. That failed run is retained. The corrected provider uses a real parent-retaining read cursor and bounded chunks; no global budget increase or smaller acceptance limit.
